name: Python
description: Runs Python code in its own work folder with a time limit, for maths, data and charts without full command access, and keeps saved scripts (encrypted) that you or agents can run again. Pictures, audio, video and PDFs the code saves show in the chat. This is not a security sandbox: the code runs with your user's rights.

settings.name: pythonPath
settings.label: Python
settings.description: Leave empty to use Seven's own environment (set it up below) or else py/python from PATH. Or give a python.exe, for example a venv's Scripts\python.exe.

settings.name: workFolder
settings.label: Work folder
settings.description: Where scripts run and files they save land. Leave empty for .seven\sandbox\python. Files here are not encrypted.

actions.name: setup_env
actions.label: Set up environment
actions.description: Creates Seven's own Python environment and installs numpy, pandas, networkx, pillow, opencv-python, piexif, stegano, fpdf2, graphviz, jinja2, folium, mido, gTTS, trimesh, d20, requests, beautifulsoup4, crayons and colorama. Run it again to update them. Takes a few minutes. Scripts use it unless a Python path is set above.
